status: Proposed initial-broad-release scope; not implemented or validated
catalog_type: Candidate primitive and capability inventory; distinguish atomic primitives, composite components, runtime services, and adapters.
interpretation: An entry is a separately testable generalizable capability, not necessarily one function or one UI component.

priority_definitions.Critical: Must be robust before the first broad public compatibility release
priority_definitions.Core: Designed and substantially implemented before broad public release
priority_definitions.Extended: Specialized long-tail support planned for launch coverage evaluation; gate according to measured impact, not raw counts

primitive_contract.recognize: Typed evidence and deterministic matching rules; support UNKNOWN when evidence is insufficient
primitive_contract.model: Normalized state, operation types, constraints, provenance and permission context
primitive_contract.execute: Authorized deterministic path or preserved original-surface fallback
primitive_contract.verify: State transition and expected postconditions verified where possible
primitive_contract.render: Native UI, protocol-backed surface, or preserved existing widget
primitive_contract.expose: Generate CLI/API/MCP only if operation semantics are sufficiently established; generic interaction API otherwise
primitive_contract.test: Independent fixtures, cross-app compositional tests, and behavior equivalence checks
